=== Keyboard Shortcuts (? or Esc closes) ===
List: ↑/↓ or j/k move · Enter open · f favorite · Tab switch panel
Esc: leaves typing, chat, filter or search
Back to categories: Esc in the list · Ctrl+R anywhere, even while typing
Search: / filter list · Ctrl+S search Twitch channels · r retry
Player (own mpv window): Space pause/resume · +/- volume · Ctrl+X stop
Chat: i write · Enter send · Esc leave input · Ctrl+T reconnect
